post.title: Cyclic Sort: Find Missing and Duplicate Numbers in O(n) Time, O(1) Space
post.subtitle: Place every number at its correct index in one sweep — then scan for mismatches. No HashSet, no extra memory.
post.brief: If an array holds n numbers in range [1, n], each number belongs at index `num - 1`. Cyclic sort places every element at its correct index in O(n) time using O(1) space — then a single scan reveals every missing and duplicate number. Five interview problems, one technique.
